scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account, lacks identifying contact information, and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Jin Chen and I'm 70. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Jin. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I cannot pull up an account using only a name, as we have many customers with similar names. Could you please provide your full mailing address or the last four digits of the credit card used for the purchase?
Oh, I see. I don't have my card on me either, but my address is 422 Maple Avenue, Springfield. Does that help?
Thank you. Let me check our system... Okay, I see an account matching that address. To verify your identity, can you confirm the date of your last purchase with us?
I believe it was sometime last month, maybe the 15th? It was for a kitchen appliance.

That matches our records. Per our standard terms regarding account access and refunds, I need to confirm the specific order ID to process any financial transaction. Since you don't have that, I'm going to have to escalate this to our account security team who can verify your identity through alternative methods.
That sounds like a lot of trouble. Can't you just see the refund pending on your end?

I apologize for the inconvenience, but our system restricts me from accessing financial details without a verified order reference. I've created a ticket for the security team to contact you via the phone number on file to verify your identity and process the refund. They will reach out within 24 hours.

escalation_reason: Agent could not verify the customer's identity sufficiently to perform a financial transaction (refund) without an order number or secondary verification, requiring account security specialist intervention.
